name: DividedSplitting.genResidue_smul_eq_iff
summary: Write S = I_u + (reduction of an adelic matrix X); then t̄·(S̄ − I_u) = 0 modulo M² says that X vanishes modulo M, which by the Chinese remainder theorem is the vanishing at each chosen place.

steps.claim: For every entry (a, b) choose an integral adele X_{ab} with S_{ab} = I_u(a, b) + (reduction of X_{ab} modulo M²Q): the reduction Ô → O_E/M²Q is surjective, and so is adding the constant I_u(a, b).
steps.lean:
choose X e using fun a b ↦
    (add_left_surjective (inclMatrix _ u a b)).comp (reduction_surjective _) (S a b)

steps.claim: With S = I_u + X̄: t̄·(S̄ − I_u) = 0 in O_E/M² says t·X ≡ 0 mod M², i.e. (reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff with c = 2) t^{−1}X is integral, i.e. X ≡ 0 modulo M; by the Chinese remainder theorem for M = ∏ w_i (matrix_ext_modulusResidue, the chosen places being distinct) this holds iff X reduces to 0 at every chosen place, i.e. iff S reduces to I_u in every residue field k_{w_i}.
steps.lean:
simpa [inclMatrix, apply_ite (_ : _ →+* _), ← ext_iff, ← e, ← map_mul,
    reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff, sq, mul_add, mul_assoc,
    -elim_inl] using! matrix_ext_modulusResidue O.isConjApart_chosenPlace.1 (x :=
    (of X).map (O.levelModulus 1 false).reduction) (y := 0)
